parameters.content:
VIDEO VERSION — faithful reconstruction from the source evidence.
Source: https://www.instagram.com/wesbookland/reel/DdCF5u-hGKk/
Evidence: [0.08s - 104.33s] [Speaker 0] Here is the exact AI operating system that I personally use to run my own business. First is gonna be one main folder that holds everything I'm about to share with you. At the root of that, it's gonna be a cloud dot MD file with every rule, every preference of how I actually want things done. Then it's a context folder. This is the type of stuff that you would need to have a new employee step in and understand everything about the business. That's gonna include a profile file with who I am and how I talk so that the AI writes like me, a positioning file that explains exactly what I do and what sets me apart, then an offer file with exactly what I sell and how it's structured, a brand guidelines file, so anything that it makes actually looks like us, a skills folder with every routine that we run more than once so that it can run it the exact same way every single time. All of that is connected to cloud code so that I'm not the one personally doing the work. And MCP layer wired in so it pulls in from my calendar, my drive, and my actual tools. A memory layer stacked on top of that so it members what we've already decided and worked on so I'm not starting over every single session. Then I connect linear to it on top of that so that me, my team, and AI are all operating from the same project management system. Apify connected so that anytime we need to pull data from the web, it can do that in the background. My meta ad account connected to see which ads are performing the best. My CRM connected so it sees every lead and every follow-up and knows which ads are turning into money instead of just clicks. My website repository connected so that we can make changes with all of the context that I mentioned above. My Fathom account connected to use meeting notes as direction for to do's and proper context, my accounting tool connected so that I can track expenses and monthly profit and loss statements, and then all of this documented into one single document so that if I bring somebody new in, they know exactly how to run this tool. Now, obviously, this can be a lot more personalized for yourself than it is for myself. So if you want the exact same framework and setup, comment AI OS, and I'll send you over a prompt so that you can create your AI operating system for your business.
